_comment: The counterfactual for tests/unit/test_unearth.py: `t_unearther` with its leave-the-battlefield replacement written as `replace_deaths`, which catches a death and nothing else -- so the card survives a bounce and can be unearthed again. Identical in every other respect, so the tests measure that one op. Never part of a deck list.
